n: A faded banner, one of hundreds. The last battle of the old world was meant to be fought here. It never was.
u: One banner, standing apart from the others. A single name is stitched on it.
You know that name. You taught him to hold a sword. Aurelio. The memory is warm, and sad, and yours.
Q: A portal of old stone, humming, sealed. Beyond it, far off, the sound of water and coins.
It isn't ready yet. Neither, maybe, are you.
1: The way back north, past the old watchtower.

objects.name: Professor Hoot
lines: Hoo. You've been staring at this screen a while.
Have you had water today? The next dungeon will still be here. Go on.
